prompt:
Image 1 is only a palette and art-style reference (Hiro the plain hero: grey steel armour over leather, a worn green cloak, a plain steel longsword with four tiny dull stones in its guard). Do NOT draw the character or the sword.

Create an 8-frame GROUND spell VFX sprite sheet, one continuous sequence: a plain GROUND SHOCK under an enemy after a heavy sword blow (the enemy is NOT drawn; the middle stays empty magenta). The ground line is fixed at 92% of the cell height. Frame 1: a thin crack line appears on the ground. Frame 2: radial cracks spread in a flat ellipse. Frame 3: small rocks and dust pop up along the cracks. Frame 4: a low ring of dust rises. Frame 5: dust at its widest, a few rock chips flying. Frame 6: dust falling. Frame 7: cracks fading. Frame 8: a faint crack and specks.
PLAIN and MODEST: this is the free starter hero, so the effect is simple and down to earth. Painted as OPAQUE solid shapes with crisp edges: no glow halo, no haze, no sparkles, no gold light, no jewels, no rainbow colours, no magic runes. No pink, no purple, no magenta tint. Colours only sandy brown, stone grey, pale beige.
Exactly 8 frames in a 4 columns x 2 rows grid of equal square 512x512 cells, total image 2048x1024, read left-to-right then next row. Nothing crosses a cell edge; leave a magenta margin of at least 6% on all sides of every cell. Background 100% solid flat #FF00FF magenta in every cell, no gradient, no text, no labels, no borders, no gridlines. Clean HD smooth painted anime game VFX, NOT pixel art.

problems.detail: The dust clouds are pale pink/peach rather than the sandy brown, stone grey, pale beige the prompt specifies, and the prompt explicitly bans pink.

The widest dust in frame 5 reaches to about x=14 of its 256px cell, which is roughly at or just inside the required 6% magenta margin, so the margin may be slightly violated. The output is also 1024x512 rather than the requested 2048x1024.

precheck.summary: The sheet has the right 8-frame 4x2 arrangement and the sequence follows the prompt (crack, radial cracks, rocks and dust, ring, widest dust, falling, fading, faint crack), with a flat magenta background and no extra content. The defects are mostly colour drift toward pink and a possibly tight margin on frame 5, so I can't call it a clear fail.
